{{Infobox artifact|name=The Songs|type=Oral folk tradition|keeper=Everyone, and no one}}
'''The Songs''' are the oral tradition of [[the Banner-lands]] — songs and children's rhymes no ruler ever censored, because no ruler ever could. They carry fragments of truth the official sources cleaned away.

One rhyme counts ''"…eight, nine, ten, and one who left."'' Another sends its listener ''"…to Elvestad, where the eleventh prayed."'' The Songs misremember everything unimportant and, somehow, nothing important.
